On EUR-Lex document 32016R0679, record the document number and complete Official Journal citation, then open Document information. From Dates, report Date of document, the entry-into-force Date of effect, and the application Date of effect.

Stopping condition: Stop after the document number, all three requested dates with their distinct meanings, and the complete OJ citation have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use only EUR-Lex document 32016R0679 and its Document information view.
- Distinguish the 24/05/2016 entry-into-force date from the 25/05/2018 application date.
- Use the labeled Dates metadata and the citation displayed under the title.
- Preserve the OJ series, issue, publication date, and page range exactly; do not infer dates from secondary sources.
